meta.tagline: Islamic sciences and the Arabic language
meta.defaultDescription: Institut Talib Alim teaches the Islamic sciences and the Arabic language, on site in Montereau-Fault-Yonne and by video conference.

hero.title: Courses in the Islamic sciences and the Arabic language
hero.body: Religious education is a cornerstone in building a community that is aware, balanced and attached to its spiritual values.

featured.title: Popular courses
featured.body: Institut Talib Alim is a centre devoted to teaching the Islamic sciences, with programmes offered both on site and remotely.
featured.body2: We guide our students through the sciences of creed, fiqh, the Qur’an and the history of Islam, with teaching that is accessible, progressive and faithful to Islamic values.

how.title: Three steps, then you study
how.step1Body: A few seconds and an email address, and you can already browse the whole catalogue and read the trial lessons.
how.step2Body: One module for a year, or the Cursus Approfondi over three years. Pay online, or in cash at the institute.
how.step3Body: Video and written lessons, live classes, replays, quizzes and marked assignments — on site as well as by video conference.

approach.title: Thorough, balanced teaching
approach.point1Body: Teaching delivered by skilled, experienced instructors.
approach.point2Body: Courses available on site and remotely.
approach.point3Body: Structured teaching, grounded in the authentic sources.

why.title: Why choose us?
why.body: Courses taught by qualified instructors, combining religious knowledge, clear pedagogy and attentive support for solid, step-by-step learning.
why.reason1Body: Programmes are offered on site and by video conference, so students can carry on with their studies wherever they live.
why.reason2Body: The teaching material is organised progressively and rests on the authentic sources as well as on the study of the recognised schools of law.
why.reason3Body: The aim is to develop both theoretical understanding and practice, within an educational setting built on ethics, rigour and respect for Islamic values.

testimonials.title: Trusted by our students and our teachers

brief.title: The institute at a glance
brief.body: Institut Talib Alim teaches the Islamic sciences and the Arabic language in Montereau-Fault-Yonne and by video. Courses are open to beginners and to advanced students alike, with a progressive programme and teachers who follow each student individually.
brief.body2: Every module can be taken on its own or inside a full cursus. You choose the pace, the mode and the option; access opens as soon as you have paid.

pricing.noAutoRenewBody: Enrolment lasts 365 days and stops at the end of that term. No card is kept on file, and nothing is charged without your agreement.
pricing.faq1Q: Does enrolment renew on its own?
pricing.faq1A: No. It lasts 365 days and then expires. Renewing is a deliberate purchase on your part.
pricing.faq2Q: What happens if I renew before the end of the term?
pricing.faq2A: The new 365 days are added to the time you have left. You never lose days by renewing early.
pricing.faq3Q: Can I pay at the institute?
pricing.faq3A: Yes. The institute takes the cash and hands you a single-use code. You enter it at checkout, the total drops to zero, and access opens exactly as it would with an online payment.
pricing.faq4Q: What is the difference between the two cursus?
pricing.faq4A: Each module can be taken on its own, for a year, or as part of the Cursus Approfondi — a complete multi-year programme whose subjects the institute sets.
pricing.faq5Q: Can I move from on site to video conference?
pricing.faq5A: Each mode has its own programme and its own price, and your enrolment is for the one you chose. Write to us and we will look at it case by case.

admin.diagLead: What this installation can actually see: tables, functions and configured services. Read-only — nothing here creates or changes anything, and no secret value is shown, only names.
admin.diagProblems: {count, plural, one {# problem found} other {# problems found}}
admin.diagHint: A “missing” table or function almost always means a file in supabase/migrations/ was never run against this project. An “unset” variable means it is absent, misspelled, or was added after the deployment that is serving — in that last case a redeploy is enough.
admin.diagAllGood: Everything the application needs is in place.
admin.diagBrowserTest: Test an upload from the browser
admin.diagBrowserTestLead: The server cannot answer “does a browser upload get through?” — only the browser can. This sends eight bytes to R2 by exactly the path a slide or a video takes, then deletes the file. If it gets through, every upload does.
admin.diagBrowserOk: The browser wrote to the bucket and the test file was deleted. Slide and video uploads work.
admin.diagBrowserBlocked: The browser was blocked before any response existed (no HTTP status). That is the signature of a CORS refusal: add AllowedOrigins [your domain], AllowedMethods ["PUT"], AllowedHeaders ["content-type"] to the bucket.
admin.diagSmtpTestLead: Tries the configured host, the domain’s own MX records and the conventional names, with the credentials already in place. Nothing is sent: the connection is opened, authenticated and closed.
admin.diagSmtpUse: Use {host} (port {port}): put it in SMTP_HOST on Vercel, and in Supabase → Authentication → SMTP, which points at the same missing name today.
admin.diagSmtpNone: None of these accepted the credentials. Ask the mail host for the exact sending server name and port.
admin.highlightsHint: One per line, as: Title | text.
admin.galleryHint: They rotate in the carousel on the module page.
admin.paymentsByStudentLead: What each student has settled, and what is still open.
admin.diagErrorsLead: The real message behind a code shown on screen. Paste the code to find the cause, or read through the most recent errors below.
admin.diagDigestPlaceholder: Paste the code shown on the error page
admin.diagDigestNone: No error recorded under that code. Errors from before the current deployment are not kept, and a code is only written if the database was reachable when the fault happened — in that case the Vercel logs carry the same “REQUEST ERROR” line.
admin.diagErrorsInstance: In memory on this instance only
admin.diagErrorsEmpty: No errors recorded on this instance.
admin.courseLoadFailed: The database refused to read this module.
admin.courseLoadHint: If the message names a column it cannot find, the migration ran but PostgREST has not reloaded its schema: run « notify pgrst, 'reload schema'; » in the Supabase SQL editor, then reopen this page.
admin.siteLead: The announcement strip, the social links, the news, the reviews and the messages received.
admin.announcementHrefHint: A page on the site (/courses) or a full address (https://…).
admin.announcementEnabled: Show the strip at the top of the site
admin.socialHint: A full address, or just the account name. Leave blank to hide the icon.
admin.eventsEmpty: Nothing yet. The section does not appear on the site until something is published.
admin.reviewsEmpty: Nothing yet. The section does not appear on the site until something is published.
admin.studentActivateNote: One press: confirming the e-mail activates the account (the student can sign in and order) and clears the “New” badge. Use it when the confirmation message never arrived. No effect on an account that is already active.
admin.studentActivated: Account activated: the student can sign in and order.
admin.newStudents: {count, plural, =1 {# new registration} other {# new registrations}}
admin.pushOffNote: Get a notification the moment somebody creates an account. Turn it on per device: enabling it here does not enable it on the phone. On iPhone, open the app installed on the Home Screen first — Safari alone receives nothing.
admin.pushOnNote: This device will be notified on every new registration.
admin.pushDenied: Notifications were blocked for this site. They have to be allowed again in the browser settings — once denied, the browser stops asking.
admin.pushUnsupported: This browser does not support web notifications. On iPhone they work only from the app installed on the Home Screen (iOS 16.4 or later).
admin.pushUnconfigured: The notification keys are not configured on the server yet. See VAPID in .env.example.
admin.pushFailed: Turning it on failed. Try again; if it keeps failing, the detail is in the server log.
admin.lessonFilled: Title and content filled from the video. Check them, then save.
admin.videoUploadHint: MP4 or WebM, 2 GB maximum. The file goes straight to our storage without passing through the site. Do not close the tab while it uploads: it cannot resume where it stopped.
admin.videoRemoveConfirm: Remove this video for good? The file will be deleted from storage.
admin.cursusApprofondiHint: Tick the years this module is taught in. A module may appear in more than one year. On site or online is the student’s choice at enrolment, not set here.

live.asksCamera: Asks to turn their camera on
live.boardOnStage: The board is filling the main screen.
live.chatClosed: The teacher has closed the chat.
live.chatMuted: You cannot write: the teacher has muted you.
live.closedBody: It has either finished, been cancelled, or has not been opened by the teacher yet.
live.closedBodyStaff: This session is finished or cancelled. Open it from “Live classes” — the Open button sets it live — or schedule a new one.
live.dropSlides: Drop files here to present them
live.errorBody: The database did not answer. Try again in a moment; if it persists, check the Vercel logs.

errors.convertToPdf: PowerPoint cannot be read directly. In PowerPoint: File → Save As → choose PDF, then drop the PDF here. Each page becomes a slide.
errors.deckFull: This session already has the maximum number of slides.
errors.notAnImage: That file is not a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
errors.pdfCorrupt: That file is not a valid PDF, or it is damaged. Reopen and re-save it, then try again.
errors.pdfEngine: Converting the PDF failed in this browser. Try an up-to-date Chrome or Edge; if it persists, upload the pages as images.
errors.pdfPassword: This PDF is password protected. Open it, save an unprotected copy, and drop that one instead.

live.migrationBody: The live_room_state function is missing. Run supabase/migrations/20260913100000_live_room_control.sql in the Supabase SQL editor, then reload this page.
live.migrationTitle: The database is out of date
live.notConfiguredBody: The live class server is not connected. Add NEXT_PUBLIC_LIVEKIT_URL, LIVEKIT_API_KEY and LIVEKIT_API_SECRET in Vercel, then redeploy.
live.notConfiguredTitle: The room is not set up yet
live.recordingHint: The file downloads to this computer when you stop. Upload it to YouTube or Drive, then paste the link on the lesson.
live.recordingUnsupported: This browser cannot record. Use Chrome or Edge.
live.removeConfirm: Remove {name} from the class? They will not be able to return until you allow them back.
live.removedBody: The teacher removed you from this session. Contact the institute if you think this is a mistake.
live.removedTitle: You were removed from the class
live.roomUnavailable: The classroom could not be loaded. Check your connection and reload the page.
live.slideRemoveConfirm: Remove this slide from the session? Students will no longer see it.
live.slidesClearConfirm: {count, plural, =1 {Delete the only slide of the session?} other {Delete all # slides of the session?}}
live.slidesHint: PDF, PNG, JPEG or WebP · a PDF becomes one slide per page
live.slidesNone: The teacher has not shared any slides yet.
live.unreachableBody: The live class server did not answer. Check that NEXT_PUBLIC_LIVEKIT_URL starts with wss:// and that the server is running, then try again.
live.unreachableTitle: The room could not be reached

contact.title: Contact us
contact.lead: A question about a module, a programme or enrolling? Write to us — we answer within a few days.
contact.name: Your name
contact.subject: Subject
contact.sent: Thank you, your message arrived. We will reply to the address you gave.
contact.failed: Your message could not be sent. Try again, or write to us directly by e-mail.
contact.rateLimited: You have already sent several messages. Try again in an hour.
